title: Story Customizer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners decide which story elements to customize and how deeply (light, medium, or deep) for a healthcare CFO, a startup CTO, and a manufacturing CEO, and see each customized version.

learningObjectives: Adapt a base story for different customers by selecting customization elements (industry reference, persona language, specific examples) and adjusting the level of personalization.
prerequisites: Story Customization and Dynamic Story Adaptation sections of Chapter 11

keyQuestions: Adapt a base story for different customers by selecting customization elements (industry reference, persona language, specific examples) and adjusting the level of personalization.
commonMisconceptions: The same story works for everyone.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct elements and level for all three buyers.
Learner can explain why deep personalization is not always the best choice.
